protocol.target: AMFI category monthly net flow in INR crore
protocol.supplemental_horizon: 4 supports the next three full calendar months plus the next-release nowcast
protocol.selection_metric: mean absolute error divided by the forecast-origin AUM, averaged equally across category and primary horizon
protocol.selection_rule: choose one global candidate on development targets only; freeze that name before scoring final test targets
protocol.macro_missing: never zero-fill; carry latest earlier observed value with age and missing indicators
protocol.macro_vintage_limit: latest available historical handbook values are not original-release vintages

intervals.method: rolling signed forecast errors normalized by their origin AUM, recentered at their median
intervals.eligibility: forecast target month must be no later than the current known-AMFI origin month
intervals.guarantee: coverage is measured out of sample and is not guaranteed

policy.baseline: max(0, actual net outflow for the same calendar month last year)
policy.literal_cost: annual_gap * days/365 * max(buffer - realized_positive_net_outflow, 0) + penalty * max(realized_positive_net_outflow - buffer, 0)
policy.constraint: buffer capped at known origin AUM; uncapped recommendation is also retained
policy.note: the brief's 3x penalty is read as 3 rupees per rupee of shortfall; a yield-gap reading is reported as a sensitivity

prohibited: calibration residuals whose targets are not yet known
model selection on final test results
protocol.point_forecast_postprocessing: rolling signed-error median bias correction for every candidate; uncorrected seasonal naive is separately reported

selection.selection_metric: mean absolute error divided by the forecast-origin AUM, averaged equally across category and primary horizon

point_definition: All candidate point forecasts include a rolling prior-error median bias correction. Pure uncorrected seasonal naive is also reported. The cash-policy baseline uses the literal prior-year outflow.

release_block_diagnostics.method: 3000 circular bootstrap replicates of three consecutive target-release months; within-release category/horizon predictions stay together
release_block_diagnostics.note: 144 forecasts span 24 target months, so they are not independent

break_even_quantiles.formula: shortfall_cost / (shortfall_cost + idle_cost); the 95% buffer is a fixed rule, not tuned to either

driver_ablations.interpretation: positive means the group helped the fixed Ridge specification; negative means its removal improved it

limitations: 87 months per category, so tail quantiles rest on few observations.
Older AMFI layouts that combine liquid and money-market funds are excluded, not spliced.
AMFI revisions and latest-vintage RBI tables mean history is not an exact original-release replay.
Macro inputs use a fixed two-month publication lag.
Advance-tax months are also quarter ends; monthly data cannot separate the two effects.
Interval coverage is measured on 24 test months and can drift with regime changes.
MAPE is unstable when net flow is near zero; rupee and AUM-scaled errors are reported too.
Monthly net flow hides gross and intra-month redemptions, which a single fund also needs.
